messages:
deploy-bot: started canary run id=canary-0326-17 for service=streaming-models wave=3/5

deploy-bot: healthcheck failing on hosts: model-host-7, model-host-8; 5xx rate 18% (threshold 10%)

Maya Chen: noticed alerts in the dashboard. paging on-call. @sam_patel can you take a look?

Maya Chen: graphs show queue depth and mem spikes on those two hosts. possible cache regress.

Sam Patel: on it — pulling runtime logs and proxy traces now.

Ria Gomez: any customer impact visible? are streaming sessions dropping or just internal retries?

Sam Patel: tails look like repeated `502` and `503` from runtime pool. sample:
```
2026-03-26T17:05:12Z model-host-7 proxy ERROR upstream returned 502 for req=tx-55a
2026-03-26T17:05:13Z model-host-8 runtime WARN queue_depth=128 memory_pressure=high
```

Sam Patel: streaming-route latencies spiking; certain tenant buckets show elevated errors. Not universal but above abort criteria.

Maya Chen: we crossed the abort threshold. initiating emergency rollback and disabling canary flag.

Maya Chen: @ops-bot abort canary canary-0326-17 wave=3 reason="healthcheck/5xx spike"

ops-bot: abort received. beginning rollback of wave 3 -> reverting to previous model variant and rerouting traffic.

Sam Patel: running rollback cmd:
```
rbctl rollback --id canary-0326-17 --wave 3 --force --note "5xx spike & failing healthchecks"
```

Sam Patel: flipping feature flag `canary_wave_3=true` -> set to false now.

Ria Gomez: drafting customer comms. short note: "We briefly rolled out an update to a subset of streaming infrastructure that caused intermittent 5xx responses for some customers. The rollout was halted and services are stable. We're investigating."

Maya Chen: creating incident record INC-2026-0326-01 and adding initial timeline.

Maya Chen: Incident summary:
- symptom: canary wave 3 caused elevated 5xx and failing healthchecks on model-host-7/8
- mitigation: rollback executed at 2026-03-26T17:07:40Z, canary wave paused and flag disabled
- customer impact: intermittent 5xx for a subset of streaming customers for ~3 minutes
- next: postmortem to determine model variant diff and KV cache behavior

Sam Patel: after rollback 5xx dropped quickly. quick metrics:
- wave-targeted 5xx: 18% -> 1.8% within 90s
- healthchecks: hosts recovered after restart and cache warm-up

ops-bot: rollback complete. traffic restored to stable hosts. wave 3 aborted.

Maya Chen: handing off to @Sam for the deep-dive postmortem. oncall rotation, please watch for 30-60m to ensure no regressions.

Sam Patel: ack. follow-ups I'll own:
- reproduce KV cache thrash locally with the new model variant
- add queue-depth and prefix-latency to canary healthchecks
- tighten abort thresholds specifically for streaming-route

Ria Gomez: CS note ready to send to impacted customers. will wait for PM approval. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen: closing active paging, moving thread to postmortem/tracking. re-open if alerts spike again.

Sam Patel: creating postmortem ticket and attaching traces + diffs. thanks everyone."
